title: TypeScript SDK reliability and runtime refresh
highlights: The TypeScript SDK now ships current jcode runtimes instead of the v0.67.1 runtime
Launched SDK sessions shut down reliably even when daemon registration is delayed
improvements: Platform runtime packages are refreshed together at SDK version 1.2.0
fixes: Linux ARM64 release builds use the platform-native C character type for terminal lookup
Anthropic OAuth sessions use a runtime that tolerates unavailable usage reporting while preserving inference
